assets.prompt: Edit the supplied greenhouse scene into a matching illustration of CONTAINER GROWING ON A PAVED FLOOR. Images 2 and 3 are the approved style authority: broad discrete colour planes, crisp cream highlight strokes, no fine texture or black outline. Replace ALL internal brick raised beds and their soil with a continuous level floor of pale paving slabs; keep only a very LOW perimeter plinth supporting the greenhouse. Inside along the far side place a robust wooden slatted staging table on four sturdy legs with diagonal bracing, holding three modest terracotta pots of leafy seedlings. Along the nearer side on the FLOOR put one large terracotta pot holding a single tomato on a cane and one simple dark green growing bag with two short plants; no writing or logos on the bag. No soil beds, no high internal brickwork, no people, no lettering, no labels, no arrows. Show full structure, comfortable margins, genuinely transparent background, no halo or vignette. This will print approximately 80mm wide as one of three equal growing options in a British gardening book; simplify foliage and glazing reflections so floor and staging remain obvious.
